candidates.name: Krasnodar Krai-Crimea Gas Pipeline (Kuban-Crimea)
candidates.to: Crimea (Dzhankoi/Simferopol; Simferopol spur 27.3 km), occupied Ukraine

evidence.note: Kuban-Crimea pipeline 395-400 km, 4 bcm/y capacity, crosses Kerch Strait; construction completed late Nov 2016, commissioning end-2016.

~400 km, 16 km underwater section, 700 mm main line with two 500 mm branches, supplies Simferopol and Sevastopol power plants (page text carries a stale 2022/23 date line; content is the 2016 commissioning).
Kuban-Crimea pipeline completed 2016 via Kerch Strait, 4.4 bcm/y capacity; now feeds reverse flow to Kherson/Zaporizhzhia.

candidates.why_maybe_new: GGIT has no row (per slice brief). Does not match P1470/P5551 (Krasnodar Krai-Serpukhov, different corridor) nor P2425/P2426 (Anapa feeders for TurkStream). RU-UA cross-border per GEM naming conventions (Crimea = Ukraine), Ukraine terminus. Length ~359-400 km (sources differ; 358.7 km incl. Simferopol 27.3 km spur is one cited figure, not independently verified here). OSM seed ~135.2 km is only a partial trace (name_hint P1470 is a false match). Strong lead; possibly stage mainline + Simferopol spur separately.

candidates.name: Dzhankoi-Genichesk Gas Pipeline (Crimea-Kherson Oblast reverse-flow trunk)
aka: газопровод из Крыма в Херсонскую область
candidates.to: Genichesk, Kherson Oblast (Arabat Spit new town branch)

evidence.note: Pipeline being built from Crimea to Genichesk agglomeration in Kherson Oblast, in reverse mode versus the old Kherson-Crimea flow; length not stated.
Main gas pipeline from Crimea into Kherson Oblast completed/rebuilt Oct 2023; gas to Genichesk area raised to 160 thousand m3/day. Length not stated.
Governor Saldo: new reverse gas pipeline Crimea to southern Kherson Oblast built, 1.7 bn rubles invested.

candidates.why_maybe_new: out_of_slice: lies in/between Crimea and Kherson Oblast, both occupied Ukraine = Ukraine-internal per naming conventions; not a Russia row. Length unknown (possibly 30-60 km Dzhankoi-Genichesk, unverified). Related existing rows are only P5989/P7817/P7818 (Taganrog-Melitopol-Berdyansk), which do not cover this. Route Berdyansk-Melitopol (>100 km, Kommersant 2022, https://www.kommersant.ru/doc/5459063) is covered by P5989/P7818.

candidates.name: Gas pipeline-branch to Novolakskoe (Novolaksky-Khasavyurt district branch)
aka: отвод на Новолакский и Хасавюртовский районы
candidates.from: Mozdok-Kazimagomed trunk (Dagestan tap, exact point not stated)

evidence.note: New 29.3 km, 325 mm branch built on a new route in 2024 replacing the 1986 159 mm line; reconstruction completed.
Same: 29.3 km, 325 mm, new alignment instead of modernising the old 159 mm main.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Not in roster (no Novolak/Khasavyurt branch row; P1477 Kumli-Kizlyar and P0751 are different). Parent trunk is P0751 (Hajigabul-Shirvanovka-Mozdok / Mozdok-Kazimagomed). Just above the 25 km floor (29.3 km); it is a regional spur, and the old 1986 159 mm branch may also be uncaptured. Medium-weak: tap point not identified.

candidates.name: Sochi-Sukhumi Subsea Gas Pipeline (Russia-Abkhazia)
aka: газопровод по дну Черного моря в Абхазию
candidates.from: Tuapse-Adler gas pipeline branch, Sochi/Adler area, Krasnodar Krai

evidence.note: Proposed underwater pipeline Sochi-Sukhumi from the Tuapse-Adler branch, cost estimated 90 bn rubles, Gazprom took part in development; length not stated.
Abkhazia energy minister says gasification schemes for the republic developed with Russian organisations; no length/cost/timing.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for any Russia-Abkhazia line (P0744 Dzuarikau-Tskhinvali is South Ossetia). RU-GE cross-border. Concept stage only, length unknown (Adler-Sukhumi straight line roughly 100 km, inference only, not sourced). Weak; include for monitor-level tracking, vetting agent should check for a firm Gazprom decision before staging.

candidates.name: Nevinnomyssk-Mozdok Gas Pipeline (second string)
candidates.why_maybe_new: OSM-only lead (~257.0 km merged). Matches P2343 Mozdok-Nevinnomyssk (257 km, dia 820, 1020), likely a parallel string of the same corridor; GEM tracks multi-string systems with '/ II' suffix rows elsewhere (e.g. P5551, P5665). No independent source stating a second string was found in web searches (no cite; OSM and gem.wiki are leads only). Consolidator should decide whether P2343 already folds both strings (dia 820 + 1020 suggests two strings) before any vetting; likely NOT new.
